surfaces.label: Goal and scope
surfaces.description: Problem/goal, intended outcome and development boundary are explicit.

surfaces.label: Current state and desired delta
surfaces.description: Relevant current state is bound and the intended change from it is explicit.

surfaces.label: Functional behaviour
surfaces.description: Foreseeable changed/new user-visible and system behaviour is specified.

surfaces.label: Actors and permissions
surfaces.description: Relevant actors, roles, permissions and authority effects are explicit or not applicable.

surfaces.label: Main flows
surfaces.description: Primary changed/new user and system flows are defined.

surfaces.label: Edge and error states
surfaces.description: Material edge, error, empty and loading states are defined or explicitly not applicable.

surfaces.label: Data and lifecycle
surfaces.description: Material data creation, mutation, migration, retention and deletion effects are defined or not applicable.

surfaces.label: Security and privacy
surfaces.description: Material security/privacy implications and constraints are resolved or explicitly not applicable.

surfaces.label: Compatibility, performance and runtime
surfaces.description: Material compatibility, performance, environment and runtime constraints are resolved or not applicable.

surfaces.label: Observability and recovery
surfaces.description: Required diagnostics, monitoring, rollback and recovery behaviour are defined or not applicable.

surfaces.label: Acceptance coverage
surfaces.description: Requested behaviour has falsifiable acceptance checks and no material acceptance gap remains.

surfaces.label: Out of scope
surfaces.description: Relevant exclusions and non-goals are explicit.

surfaces.label: Unresolved assumptions
surfaces.description: No material unresolved assumption remains; non-material residual assumptions are explicit.
